description: This file contains the implementation of the Hogan templating engine, including template rendering, parsing, and compilation functions, as well as regex-based template scanning and helpers.

classes.name: Hogan.Template
classes.description: Class representing a Hogan template with methods for rendering, partials, sections, and variable processing.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.prototype.render
methods.description: Renders the template with the given context, partials, and indentation.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.prototype.rp
methods.description: Finds and renders a partial by name within the current scope.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.prototype.rs
methods.description: Renders a section, iterating over array contexts.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.prototype.s
methods.description: Starts a section based on a value, handling booleans, arrays, and functions.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.prototype.d
methods.description: Finds values with dotted notation in the context.

methods.name: Hogan.Template.prototype.f
methods.description: Finds values with normal names in the context.
